notApplicable.pressed: Form does not expose a pressed container; submit action feedback belongs to Button and fields retain their own interactions.
notApplicable.selected: Form manages field records rather than a selectable container.
notApplicable.expanded: Popup fields own expansion; the Form layout has no expansion protocol.
notApplicable.loading: The equivalent applicable state is validating, sampled with live animation and video in form-motion.visual.spec.mjs.
